title: PostgreSQL
scope: A deep PostgreSQL curriculum covering SQL, MVCC, indexing, planner internals, VACUUM, WAL, replication, partitioning, JSONB, extensions, security, observability, high availability, logical replication, and production engineering.
coverage_note: PostgreSQL 18 current stable baseline, with upgrade-aware coverage
